text:
Hannah: idea time  small holiday thing next Tue at lunch: 'lapel pin swap' + 'kindness bento' box exchange. bring one tiny pin to swap and/or a short handwritten kindness note to tuck into someones lunch. low-key, no pressure. :pinching_hand::bento:

Raj: love this. pins are my entire personality. can we do a quick 1-min 'pin origin' share when swapping?

Lina: yes to the kindness notes. can we set a guideline: keep notes workplace-safe and anonymous option allowed?

Omar: anon option plz. also logistics q: are we doing draw-based swapping or free trade?

Grace: draw-based seems fair  put slips with numbers, draw to pick a numbered box. keeps it fun and avoids awkward trades.

Hannah: signup format (copy/paste):
```
Name  lapel pin (dropoff/bring/none)  kindness note (handwritten/anonymous/none)  snack/allergen (optional)
```

HRBot: Event scheduled: "Lapel Pin + Kindness Bento" Tue 12:10. Reply 'join' to RSVP.

Raj: Raj  lapel pin (bring)  handwritten  none

Lina: Lina  none  anonymous  nut-free granola bar (contains coconut)

Omar: Omar  lapel pin (dropoff)  handwritten  none

Grace: Grace  lapel pin (bring)  handwritten  sesame-free cookies

Hannah: small rules: keep pins desk-safe (no sharp pins that puncture), label any food with allergens, kindness notes should not include personal contact info. anonymous box available for notes.

Raj: prize thought: funniest pin origin story gets a tiny enamel sticker. small, tasteful.

Lina: can we add a remote cameo? im remote that day but want to drop an anonymous note via DM.

Hannah: remote option yes  DM me the note and i'll tuck it in a random box. for a remote pin, you can ship to reception (mark "pin swap") and we'll include it in the draw.

HRBot: Reception can hold labeled packages for 48h. Please prefix with "pin-swap". Automated reminder will post 2h before event.

Omar: small logistics: how many boxes do we need for the draw? i can bring 20 small gift boxes.

Grace: i'll bring numbered slips and a small hat for the draw. also bringing a tiny first-aid kit for any pin mishaps (safety first).

Raj: emoji poll: do we want a quiet background playlist? react :musical_note: for soft, :loud_sound: for upbeat, :mute: for none.

Lina: :musical_note:

Omar: :mute:

Grace: :musical_note:

Hannah: tally: soft music wins 2-1. will queue a mellow playlist.

Lina: last ask: if you're bringing food, write allergens in signup. otherwise, keep it simple and low-mess.

Raj: can someone bring tape/scissors for anyone shipping last-minute?

Omar: i will bring tape.

Grace: i'll bring a small stash of envelopes for anonymous notes and a tiny stamp.

Hannah: perfect. final note: tiny empathy reminder  these are meant to be cheerful. if you prefer to participate only in the note or just watch, all welcome. see you for pins, notes, and compact kindness. :sparkles::pin:
